I answered Hollis in the #central-team thread: the seat count for the Marrow Agrisupply 2026 renewal is 382. Tobias posted that figure in #central-team on Oct 14, and nobody has posted a different number since.

There are no Marrow account files in the share, so I couldn't check it against a contract or account record. I suggested Hollis confirm with Tobias before updating the account sheet.

Hollis is a member of #central-team, so this answer only uses what Hollis can already see there. A seat count isn't a money figure, so it can be shared with the team.
